GitCode software-inspired theme palettes

The VS Code, IDEA and GitHub presets adapt interface color roles for GitCode.
They do not reproduce the complete interface or syntax themes of those products.
Theme names identify the source of design inspiration; no affiliation is implied.

References:
- Microsoft Visual Studio Code / Dark Modern (MIT):
  https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/blob/main/extensions/theme-defaults/themes/dark_modern.json
- JetBrains IntelliJ Platform / Dark (Apache-2.0):
  https://github.com/JetBrains/intellij-community/blob/master/platform/platform-resources/src/themes/expUI/expUI_dark.theme.json
- GitHub Primer / GitHub VS Code themes (MIT):
  https://github.com/primer/github-vscode-theme
  https://github.com/primer/primitives

Palette values and role choices are recorded in electron/theme-presets.json.
Selected text and control colors are adjusted for readability in GitCode.

Additional JetBrains presets: Light, Darcula, Islands Dark/Light/Darcula.
Color roles were checked against a copied local IntelliJ IDEA resource JAR.
Source build and resource hashes: design/theme-presets/research/idea-local-theme-sources.json
Islands implementation guidance: https://plugins.jetbrains.com/docs/intellij/supporting-islands-theme.html
Darcula reference: https://github.com/JetBrains/intellij-community/blob/master/platform/platform-resources/src/themes/darcula.theme.json
Light reference: https://github.com/JetBrains/intellij-community/blob/master/platform/platform-resources/src/themes/expUI/expUI_light.theme.json
